ModMetaData.name: Relation Based Trading
ModMetaData.author: TheLoneTec, Sonsalt
ModMetaData.description:
Trader stock follows your goodwill with that faction. Better relations unlock better goods: more expensive, higher quality, more dangerous and more advanced.
There are no fixed steps; every point of goodwill opens a little more: - Value: the most expensive item a faction will sell grows from 150 silver at goodwill -75 to about 1,000 at 0 and 6,700 just below 75. From 75 (Ally) there is no limit. - Weapons, ammo and explosives only from goodwill 25, and they count four times their price against that limit, so cheap weapons come first and the best only near Ally. - Quality: Normal at -75, up to Legendary from 56. Better items are lowered to the limit. - Tech: relative to the faction's own tech level (two below at -75, one above from 50). Archotech only from spacer factions, at Ally. Food, raw materials, animals and plants are always available. Below -75 traders sell nothing. Orbital traders and traders without a faction are not filtered. When goodwill drops, settlement stock above the new limits is removed; when it rises by 15 or more, the stock is regenerated. Every limit can be changed in the mod settings. Safe to add to or remove from a running save.
2.1.1: RimWorld 1.6 tested; exact tech steps; trader books are priced without being rebuilt. 2.1.0: gradual limits by value, quality, danger and tech instead of fixed tech tiers. Full list in CHANGELOG.md.
Original mod by TheLoneTec. Updated by Sonsalt, with help from Lightwave.
